title: Juicy Smoked Polish Pepper Gratin
description: A creamy, lacto-vegetarian friendly Polish dish featuring roasted pepper and smoky flavors.
instructions: Char-grill the peppers over medium-high heat until slightly charred, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the peppers to a baking sheet and let cool for 10 minutes.
Peel the peppers, removing the seeds and membranes, and cut into 1-inch pieces.
In a large saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the caraway seeds and smoked paprika; cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for an additional 1 minute.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Gradually add the heavy cream, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the mozzarella cheese until melted and smooth.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
In a large, oven-safe skillet, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the pepper pieces and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the peppers are tender and the sauce is bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
